name: toml-string-list-roundtrip
rationale: toml documents dumps as producing TOML corresponding to a Python dictionary and loads as parsing that TOML into a dictionary. TOML 0.5.0 supports homogeneous string arrays. The adapter only wraps the generated list in a fixed-key dictionary and unwraps it after parsing.
domain: Lists of 0 through 8 Python strings, each length 0 through 32, generated by Hypothesis st.text with its default alphabet excluding surrogate code points. All lists are homogeneous, including empty lists. No bytes, custom classes, mixed-type arrays, or invalid surrogate code points.
